hero.title: Launch sites that read like software systems.
hero.body: Use one manifest-driven starter to ship landing pages, pricing rails, proof cards, and roadmap narratives without copy-pasting a front-end stack into every project.

metrics.label: from blank repo to launch surface

feature_cards.title: Hero + proof stack
feature_cards.body: Prominent launch messaging, CTAs, and social proof cards are already wired into the template.

feature_cards.title: Section registry
feature_cards.body: Feature rails, timelines, case studies, and pricing copy stay content-driven.

feature_cards.title: Node packaging lane
feature_cards.body: The browser output builds through Node FFI instead of requiring Rust toolchains.

story_cards.title: Theme system
story_cards.body: Color, type, spacing, and chrome are isolated in theme manifests.

story_cards.title: Content schema
story_cards.body: Sections and cards moved out of hand-authored page code.

story_cards.title: Artifact matrix
story_cards.body: Each experience now writes HTML, manifest, and server-plan outputs.

timeline.title: Pick the archetype
timeline.body: Choose business, portfolio, immersive, chat, or actor-server mode.

timeline.title: Swap manifests
timeline.body: Replace theme, content, and scene entries instead of rewriting page code.

timeline.title: Serve locally
timeline.body: Use the packaged Node runtime to inspect the exact artifact users will see.
